title: Crystal harvesting with the Shifter microscope stage
summary: Load an unsealed crystallisation plate into the Shifter, let software park each chosen drop under a small access hole, mount crystals with loops by hand, and log annotations on the touch screen for CSV export. Reported rates are 100-240 crystals per hour.

steps.text: Remove the plate seal completely before loading.
Pass the plate through the port in the protective lid of the Shifter enclosure.
Use the touch screen to select a drop; the stage positions it under the aperture in about 30-35 s.
Fish the crystal out with a loop through the aperture using normal technique.
Record the outcome and annotations with the touch-screen buttons (timestamped automatically).
Export the log as CSV for the lab database or LIMS.

safety: Pins and cryo-tongs are used with liquid nitrogen; see the cryo-cooling protocol.

source.publisher: Acta Crystallographica Section D (IUCr, via PMC)

notes: Reported mounting rate: 100-240 per hour (mean 103, median 120). The first fetched page summary lists this but not the full methods; per-crystal time derived as about 3600/120 = 30 s median.
